description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Watchdog' class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The class is responsible for monitoring runtime health and component health periodically in an Orleans silo, reporting issues via logging. It manages background threads to periodically check system and component health, handle internal state, and log warnings or errors as needed.

classes.name: Watchdog
classes.description: Monitors runtime and component health periodically, reporting complaints.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the background threads for runtime and component health monitoring.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the health monitoring by disposing the watchdog.

methods.name: RunPlatformWatchdog
methods.description: Background thread method that periodically checks runtime health.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeHealth
methods.description: Performs health checks on the runtime, such as GC pauses and thread stalls.

methods.name: RunComponentWatchdog
methods.description: Background thread method that periodically checks component health.

methods.name: CheckComponentHealth
methods.description: Checks health of registered participants and logs issues.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Stops monitoring threads and releases resources.
